programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 3
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Just Eat
programme.desc: Just Eat follows its cast as they travel to different locations in search of exceptional culinary experiences. From popular restaurants to hidden local gems, they discover unique flavors, learn the stories behind each dish, and interact with chefs and local residents. Filled with humor, genuine reactions, and mouthwatering cuisine, the program celebrates food, culture, and the joy of sharing meals together.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life follows the Zhao family, owners of a century-old soy sauce business built on tradition and hard work. As the aging patriarch searches for a successor, his children become entangled in complicated relationships, family rivalries, business conflicts, and personal ambitions. Amid romance, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption, every family member must decide whether to preserve their family's legacy or pursue their own dreams. Through its emotional storytelling, the series celebrates perseverance, forgiveness, and the enduring strength of family bonds.

programme.title: Ra One
programme.desc: In London, Jenny Nayar, an employee of UK-based company Barron Industries, introduces a new technology that allows things from the digital world to enter the real world using wireless transmissions from multiple devices. Shekhar Subramaniam, who also works for the company, is given a final chance to devise a unique video game. To impress his skeptical son Prateek and upon the request of his wife Sonia, Shekhar uses his son's idea that the antagonist should be more powerful than the protagonist. Shekhar's colleague Akashi does the motion capture of the game's characters, Jenny does the programming, and Shekhar gives his face to the game's protagonist, G. One, while the antagonist, Ra. programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Back In The Day
programme.desc: Back in the Day follows Anthony Rodriguez, a former boxing star who returns to his hometown after years away. Struggling with personal failures and the consequences of his past decisions, Anthony reconnects with old friends, family, and memories from his youth. Through these encounters, he begins a journey of healing, forgiveness, and self-discovery as he attempts to rebuild his life and rediscover his purpose.

programme.title: Peter Bell
programme.desc: There is never a dull moment in 10-year-old Peter's life; his adventures appearing in newspaper headlines based unfortunately on outright lies. Together with his own little army, The Black Hand Club, Peter decides to right these wrongs.

programme.title: Being Frank
programme.desc: Being Frank chronicles the extraordinary life of Chris Sievey, the British comedian, musician, and creator of the fictional character Frank Sidebottom. Through interviews with family, friends, colleagues, and fellow artists, the documentary explores Sievey's rise to fame, his creative genius, the success of his unusual stage persona, and the personal challenges he faced behind the mask. The film offers an emotional and revealing portrait of an artist whose imagination brought joy to many while hiding his own struggles.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Auggie
programme.desc: Forced into early retirement, Felix Greystone falls in love with an augmented reality companion, to the detriment of his relationship with his wife and daughter.

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' tells the story of ten year-old Austen Kittredge who is sent by his father to live on his grandparents' Vermont farm, where he experiences wild adventures and uncovers long-festering family secrets. programme.title: Pro On Their Speciality
programme.desc: Pro On Their Speciality is a long-running lifestyle magazine program produced by Sanlih E-Television. Along the way, it showcases local culture, regional specialties, hidden destinations, and inspiring success stories, offering an engaging look at Taiwan's diverse communities and industries.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life follows the Zhao family, owners of a century-old soy sauce business built on tradition and hard work. As the aging patriarch searches for a successor, his children become entangled in complicated relationships, family rivalries, business conflicts, and personal ambitions. Amid romance, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption, every family member must decide whether to preserve their family's legacy or pursue their own dreams. Through its emotional storytelling, the series celebrates perseverance, forgiveness, and the enduring strength of family bonds.
